title: xDrip sends calibrations to the transmitter in non-Native mode
body:
There are reports that the event log shows " Native calibration pipe" queuing calibration for transmitter even in non-native mode.

Why would xDrip send calibrations to the transmitter in non-native mode?

This is an example case from https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/4640955485977910:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1370732/101098281-f1b48800-35c2-11eb-94a1-fe074f815b40.png)

comments.body:
I have been told that even though the message is issued that the calibration is queued, no calibration is really placed in the queue in the non-native mode.

I will be closing this as soon as I can confirm this.
